svg.title: Crackle wiring diagram
svg.desc: SR800 factory UI board (PIC16F690 U3B pins 11, 12, 17, 20 and the fan and heater command transistors), two PC817C optocouplers and two 20 kOhm / 33 kOhm dividers, a Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero, and a MAX31856 thermocouple converter with a K-type probe.
svg.text: Crackle wiring: Fresh Roast SR800 + ESP32-S3-Zero
signal reference: ESP GND ↔ U3B pin 20 (factory logic GND)
factory 5 V (incl. U3B pin 1) or 12 V rail to the ESP.
The isolated adapter is the ESP's only supply.
PC817 DIP-4: 1 anode, 2 cathode, 3 emitter, 4 collector.
Dividers 20 kΩ / 33 kΩ scale 5 V to ≈ 3.1 V.
Pins drawn schematically, not in board order.
Caution: factory logic ground is potentially mains-referenced.
Never connect a computer or grounded instrument while the roaster is plugged in.
Solder, check continuity, and flash over USB only with the roaster unplugged and the isolated adapter disconnected. Later updates go over Wi-Fi.
